findings.title: Per-trait effect lines in the Titan traits tooltip show the merged stage's capacities and pain, not the trait's
findings.detail: TitanCard.cs:57-59 calls HediffStatsUtility.SpecialDisplayStats(t.def.stage, titan). With a non-null instance, vanilla takes capMods, PainOffset and PainFactor from instance (HediffStatsUtility.cs:22, 43, 65), which is Hediff_Titan.CurStage: every discovered trait plus the material inside the hiding window, every trait when there are no hidden traits. Each discovered trait therefore lists the others' capacity and pain effects. Pass null as the second argument so stage.capMods, stage.painOffset and stage.painFactor are used (the instance==null branch at line 17). Only severity-scaled lists are lost, and BuildStage does not merge those.

findings.title: Health-tab tooltip (not in this diff) shows hidden traits' capacity and pain numbers under discovered traits
findings.detail: Hediff_Titan.TipStringExtra (Hediff_Titan.cs:668-671) has the same call with `this` as the instance. The health-tab tooltip draws outside TitanHiding's window, so CurStage is the full stage built from every trait (Hediff_Titan.cs:495-500), and hidden traits' capacity and pain numbers appear under each discovered trait. That contradicts the comment at line 650. Passing null as the instance there fixes it the same way.

findings.title: Per-trait market value lines skip the floor the stat applies
findings.detail: TraitsTip shows TitanValueUtility.TraitValue for each discovered trait. StatPart_TitanTraits.Compute clamps the total at baseValue*MinFractionOfBase - baseValue (TitanValue.cs:101-102). With heavy drawback traits, the tooltip lines can add up to a bigger drop than the Market value row shows.
